title: Phase 51C adds named electric service, fab delivery, and apprenticeship deployment evidence
summary: FTFN added two bounded In Review signals and repaired the TSMC apprenticeship signal with three official records: SRP's online Meta service project, Phoenix's current TSMC fab milestones, and a Phoenix Council agenda recording active apprenticeship cohorts.
evidence_note: The SRP record reaches a named online-service milestone. The Phoenix fab and employment facts remain labeled as company claims relayed by the City, and the apprenticeship repair reports active cohorts rather than completions. Wastewater operation, Phoenix occupancy, apprenticeship outcomes, and Toronto Council or by-law evidence remain open.
